manifest.purpose: Reproducibility record for the PISA 2018 cross-system bullying predictor analysis.

notes: QMR and QRT were excluded because the national Russian Federation entry was retained.
QAZ was retained as the Baku/Azerbaijan PISA entity represented in the supplied data.
QCI was retained as the B-S-J-Z (China) PISA entity represented in the supplied data.
CYP was not present in the supplied student dataset and was not artificially restored.

VNM contained the achievement plausible-value columns but no usable achievement PV observations; it was therefore retained in non-achievement analyses and excluded only from achievement sensitivity models.

BEINGBULLIED.definition: Official supplied PISA BEINGBULLIED bullying index; retained unchanged.

BULLY_THREAT.note: Retained as separate behavior-specific subtype; physical modality not assumed.

BULLY_PHYSICAL.combination_rule: Any observed positive -> 1; both observed and both negative -> 0; otherwise missing.

predictors.selection_rule: Common predictor set usable in every included primary system with maximum system-level missingness <=50%.

survey_design.training_weight_normalization: Within each training fold, positive finite W_FSTUWT values were divided by their mean.
survey_design.replicate_weight_use: Design-based standard errors and 95% confidence intervals for descriptive outcome estimates.
survey_design.model_uncertainty_policy: Cross-validated model performance and SHAP attribution are not presented with design-based replicate-weight confidence intervals, because valid design-based uncertainty for learned models would require refitting the learning procedure under replicate weights.

xgboost.reference_model_policy: A common reference specification was used across education systems and outcomes; no per-system hyperparameter optimization.
xgboost.parameter_interpretation: Reference specification rather than retrospectively selected best-performing specification.

shap_attribution.normalization: Feature importance shares normalized to sum to 1 within each education-system/outcome model.

cross_system_architecture.international_consensus_profile: Equal-weight mean of normalized system-level SHAP importance shares.
cross_system_architecture.reason_clustering_omitted: Results were better characterized by a conserved international architecture with continuous system-specific reweighting than by clearly separated discrete groups.

architecture_permutation_null.null_operation: Independently permute predictor labels within each system while preserving that system's exact set of normalized SHAP shares.
architecture_permutation_null.p_value_correction: (1 + number of null statistics >= observed) / (number of permutations + 1)

achievement_plausible_values.PV_variability_interpretation: Across-PV variability was used as plausible-value sensitivity, not as a sampling standard error.

missingness_robustness.strict_40pct_role: Extreme predictor-universe sensitivity only; not used to redefine the primary analysis.
missingness_robustness.preferred_low_missingness_sensitivity: Keep all 14 frozen predictors and exclude systems where any primary predictor exceeds 40% missingness.
missingness_robustness.reason: The sensitivity summarized the already-frozen 14-predictor models after restricting systems; no refitting was required.

outcome_coverage_robustness.primary_policy: Systems with any valid outcome data were retained in the primary analysis.

BELONG_removed_sensitivity.purpose: Determine whether international architectural similarity was solely caused by BELONG dominance.

conventional_benchmark.median_imputation: fit within each training fold only
conventional_benchmark.standardization: fit within each training fold only
conventional_benchmark.primary_interpretation: XGBoost was not assumed or shown to universally outperform conventional additive models. Its role is a flexible framework for nonlinear predictor-attribution profiling across systems.

directional_SHAP.continuous_feature_contrast: W_FSTUWT-weighted mean signed SHAP among observations in the upper weighted quartile minus the lower weighted quartile of the predictor.
directional_SHAP.gender_contrast: W_FSTUWT-weighted mean signed SHAP for male minus female.
